The constructor frees data on GObj creation failure without publishing it; reserved-entry setup dereferences existing shared state. The bool-declared random bound remains explicitly ambiguous.

Descriptor flags 6 and 0xA independently decode as diffuse-point and specular-point. The update copies selected source type bits into the second auxiliary; its field name cannot establish spotlight type.
Signature and payload accesses match canonical source. Source flags are cached after configuration and before auxiliary creation. Initial auxiliary types agree with independent HSD definitions.
Configuration skips the chain head and processes at most nine nodes. Initialization then caches the source chain, appends both auxiliaries, and immediately updates lighting.

The update clears hidden flags for available ranks below five, derives first-auxiliary geometry, and copies rank-1 geometry and attenuated color to the second auxiliary. Replacing diffuse with specular preserves source type bits. The document correctly clarifies the five-source upper limit.

Twenty-element work arrays and unconditional sorted-rank 1/2 accesses establish the stated necessary source-count preconditions. The cached-GObj guard does not validate those counts or auxiliary construction results.
